catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue stop class binds the fluid.pump resource kind: cap.motion.stop.v1 lists robot.arm, robot.mobile_base and motion.axis. The action is the source-backed safe-state stop (the same T command as stop_operation) that R2 requires, so it uses an extension id.

notes:
DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names family=pylabrobot and helper=PyLabRobotDriver. That helper serves a PyLabRobot LiquidHandler front end; the confirmed entry class RunzeSyringePump (unilabos/devices/pump_and_valve/runze_backbone.py:80) is a serial pump that builds framed /<address><command><R?>\r\n commands at run time (runze_backbone.py:125-133). The LaiYu files named by the card are a PyLabRobot backend whose methods mostly log and return True (laiyu_backend.py:120-333), not a complete LiquidHandler, so they do not supply a front end either. This package is therefore a direct Driver over RunzeSyringePump with native.py; the deviation is recorded here for a registry override.

COVERAGE: reads position, plunger_position, max_velocity, velocity_grade, velocity_init, velocity_end, valve_position, status, command_buffer_status, backlash_position, aux_input_status_1/2 and software_version; writes position and max_velocity with Limit.operator_required because the syringe volume is a constructor option and the clone states no numeric range; action cap.actuation.pump.v1 moves a volume in either direction, converts uL to the clone's mL and uL/s to mL/s, and returns the measured dispensed volume and elapsed time. The safe-state action x-cap.deepmodeling.stop_pump.v1 and @estop send the same T command as stop_operation through _query, then read get_status until Idle; that path takes _query_lock instead of the in-flight move's _run_lock. site-limits.example.json is an example operator overlay for a 25 mL syringe, not a claim about an instrument.

NOT COVERED: the valve port map is not exposed as a write because the clone encodes integers/floats as I<number> and accepts a string as an upper-cased command (runze_backbone.py:273-279) but states no allowed labels; set_baudrate, initialize (the Z homing command), set_velocity_grade, wait_error and the raw send_command are not exposed; the multi-address RunzeMultiplePump and the LaiYu liquid-handling backend are not integrated. The stop is a protocol stop, not a physical e-stop: bytes already in the serial driver are not flushed, the host _run loop is not cancelled, and a stop still Busy after 0.5 s is reported SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED rather than claimed. No text of the clone documents a physical e-stop, so the independent stop is the safe_state=True action. No hardware was attached or run; the fake was not compared with a device; the fake's start position, syringe volume, step count, valve label and query replies are placeholders, and its five-chunk motion is F0 test data, not the upstream simulator. driver.lock.json authored_by is the model deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run helper-wave-1-001) and reviewed_by is null; no human reviewed or tested anything. The clone stayed at 43923ec9473e2f6d33d3ca1ebca4bf4d507e06b2 and `git status --porcelain` was empty after the run.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked the direct-Driver deviation (right, as the readiness evidence predicted: RunzeSyringePump, runze_backbone.py:80, is a serial pump that frames /<address><command>R commands, 125-133, not a PyLabRobot LiquidHandler front end, and the LaiYu backend is a stub), R2, the operator-required limits, every fact, native.py and the stop. The stop is sound in kind (the T of stop_operation sent through _query, which bypasses the move's _run_lock, then the Q status read until Idle), but nothing in the clone shows T holding a later command, and the pump action read its start position after its last cancellation check and then sent the move command, so an e-stop landing in that gap was reported completed while the plunger moved afterwards (probe: 1 mL moved 0.7 s after a completed e-stop); the author's fake hid this with a sticky halt flag that also refused later moves. A position write ended early by T was reported completed with the full target applied. The reviewer added a cancellation check right before the pump's move command and right after the position move, rewrote safe_state and the docstring, corrected five facts that said more than their lines or described a method nothing calls (the max_volume unit, mL/s on set_max_velocity's lines, _adjust_total_steps, the 'so ...' inferences on stop_operation and _query) and added four (constructor step counts, Serial without a read timeout, send_command, the commented-out set_mode) (driver.py); made the fake follow the upstream and that conservative reading: T ends only the move in progress, moves hold _run_lock, stop_operation waits behind a move, the velocity uses the integer pulse frequency (fake.py); added six cases: e-stop mid-move, no move command after an e-stop in that gap, a write ended by T is cancelled, an idle T does not hold the next move, an e-stop stays unreached while the pump reports Busy, truncated velocity readback (test_driver.py); updated facts.md and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate passes with the digest unchanged (sha256:24418876fe88dbde9d7855517784f423a1ac115bb02a2e7accaf8167d3104fd7); the author's notes on the stop path and the fake are superseded where they differ. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence GPL-3.0); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: R2 syringe pump that dispenses; the hardware backend needs a human reviewed_by. The stop is the protocol T of stop_operation confirmed by the Q status; the clone has no Runze protocol document, so T's meaning rests on the method name and the Idle confirmation; T flushes nothing. The port is opened without a read timeout and every command reads until a newline under _query_lock (runze_backbone.py:102, 118-123): a silent pump blocks every command and the e-stop indefinitely (reported SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED after the budget). _run polls without a bound until the status reply is the backtick (152-164, 192-198), so any other reply (an error state) keeps the move, the action and the device lock waiting; flow rates below max_volume/6000 mL/s send V0. Conversions assume the 6000-step mode (set_mode is commented out, 206-210). The pump action never sets the valve: liquid goes to whichever port is selected.
